english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when enhancing a level, quality, status, image, or performance.
Use 提升 when the emphasis is on raising a level, standard, quality, or value rather than improving it generally.
Use this when deliberately raising a level such as quality, value, efficiency, or productivity.
Use this when the emphasis is on improving quality, performance, or living standards rather than replacing the item with a newer version.

examples.english: This new feature can enhance the phone’s user experience.
examples.traditional: 呢個新功能可以提升部手機嘅使用體驗。
